subject: bio
title: Plant cell

parts.name: Cell wall
parts.function: A layer of cellulose outside the membrane that supports the cell and keeps its shape.

parts.name: Cell membrane
parts.function: Controls what enters and leaves the cell.

parts.name: Cytoplasm
parts.function: The jelly where most of the cell's chemical reactions take place.

parts.name: Vacuole
parts.function: A large space filled with cell sap that keeps the cell firm.

parts.name: Chloroplast
parts.function: Contains chlorophyll, which absorbs light for photosynthesis.

parts.name: Nucleus
parts.function: Holds the genetic material that controls the cell.
